latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Image to Video — Convert Images Into Video Clips:

- Instantly turn your still images (JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC, up to 200MB) into 1080p animated video clips ready to download as MP4.
- No manual animation required — just upload and describe the video you want; ideal for marketers and social media creators.
- Handles session setup, authentication, file uploads, video editing prompts, and cloud rendering automatically.
- Supports common workflow commands for export, balance, status, and uploads.
- Returns high-quality video using a cloud GPU pipeline, typically within 1 minute.
- Provides robust error handling and user feedback for unsupported files, missing tokens, or credit issues.
